subject: pronghorn antelope
title: This Animal Runs 55 mph, and Nothing Alive Needs It To

scenes.text: This animal runs 55 miles an hour. And nothing alive today even needs it to.
It's the pronghorn, the fastest land animal in North America.
It isn't the fastest sprinter. A cheetah wins a short race, but over about eight hundred meters the pronghorn takes over.
Its big heart and lungs give it endurance, built for a chase that never ends.
So who was chasing it? Scientists think the American cheetah, a predator that went extinct thousands of years ago.
The hunter is long gone. The speed stayed. The pronghorn is still running from a ghost.

description:
The pronghorn runs up to 55 miles an hour, but its fastest predator is gone.
Scientists think its speed evolved to escape the extinct American cheetah.
What is the fastest animal you have ever seen?
first_comment: Would you bet on the pronghorn or the cheetah over a long race?
